# Security policy

MAW Codex packages hooks, project initializers, research-governance guidance,
and workflows that may operate near confidential data. Reports about data
exposure, destructive-command bypasses, unsafe overwrites, unintended external
actions, or misleading sandbox claims are in scope.

Use a private GitHub security advisory when the repository enables that
feature. Otherwise contact the maintainer through a private channel listed on
the repository profile. Do not publish an exploit or sensitive project
material in a public issue.

The package does not grant itself additional filesystem, network, GitHub,
email, calendar, publication, or deployment authority. A report showing that a
component bypasses this boundary is security-relevant.

Vulnerabilities in Codex, GitHub Actions, R, Stata, Python, LaTeX, Quarto, or
other dependencies should also be reported to the relevant upstream project.
